rm-protected.forbids: a recursive rm of the root directory, a home directory or a system directory
rm-protected.instead: name the one file or directory you mean by its full path

empty-variable.forbids: a destructive command (rm, mv, cp -r, chmod -R, chown -R, find -delete, truncate, shred, dd of=) whose path holds a variable or substitution, which may be empty or unexpanded
empty-variable.instead: expand the value yourself and write the full path, or write the variable as ${NAME:?} so that an empty value stops the command

find-root.instead: find in the one directory you mean

no-verify.forbids: git with --no-verify, which skips the hooks of the repository
no-verify.instead: fix what the hook refused and commit again

pipe-to-shell.forbids: downloading with curl or wget and piping it into a shell
pipe-to-shell.instead: download to a file, read it, then run it on purpose
